summary: Critical security regression: removal of HTML escaping combined with direct use of `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` on untrusted comment `body` creates an XSS vector. The change replaces the only escaping function with raw HTML insertion and supplies no sanitization or markdown renderer.

verification.reason: Comment.tsx now passes `body` straight into `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` after the patch removed the prior `escapeHtml` guard, so attacker-controlled HTML in comments can execute in viewers’ browsers. That is a real XSS regression; critical severity is appropriate for unsanitized user HTML.
